lastCompletedStory.title: Crash-proof the plan phase: try/catch forces phase:idle, sidecar survives any exception

nextStoryContext: US-005 added two crash-safety guards for the plan phase. (1) makeProductionPlanPhaseFn's returned closure now wraps its entire body in try/catch: on any exception it logs a 'sidecar-exit' event (reason:'plan-phase-crash') and calls makeSetPhaseFn(claudeDir,cwd)('idle'), then returns normally. The post-plan logic was extracted to a new runPostPlanActions helper (required by biome's 80-line limit) which calls runPostAuditAction + exitPhaseAfterPlan. (2) runSidecarLoop's planning branch now wraps await opts.runPlanPhaseFn() in try/catch: on exception it logs 'sidecar-exit' (reason:'plan-phase-crash-outer') and continues to the next tick without re-throwing. New test file test/plan-phase-crash-safety.test.ts (14 tests) covers: AC1 source-text oracle + functional closure-pattern, AC2 loop-level guard with ESCAPE pattern, AC3 real state file transition to idle. Updated test/supervisor/plan/plan-runner-postaudit.test.ts to point Group A oracle tests at runPostPlanActions (where runPostAuditAction/exitPhaseAfterPlan now live) instead of makeProductionPlanPhaseFn. File-size budget raised: sidecar.ts 985->1020, loop.ts 1595->1603, added test/plan-phase-crash-safety.test.ts 414. All 5 stories in the PRD now pass. Quality gates: 2662 tests pass, typecheck clean, check:all exit 0.

officialDocsValidated.summary: All changes are in internal cam-cli modules (sidecar.ts try/catch + runPostPlanActions helper, loop.ts outer guard, new test file). No external npm library was added or changed.
